root_cause_of_0_over_22_in_ocr_benchmark.explanation: 1) 14/22 items in `ocr_benchmark.json` are out of scope for synthetic 3D solid geometry (`12` `Oxyz` coordinate analytic geometry `c01`–`c10`, `s03`/`s03_degraded`; `1` diagram-only `c11`; `1` `Oxy` integral calculus `c12`). 2) 6/22 items (`s01`, `s02`, `s04` clean+degraded) are 1-sentence symbol-stress snippets where both Tesseract and RapidOCR have 0% recall on Unicode `⊥, ∥, ∠, √, ₁, ₂`. Notably, before our Phase 1.2 parser hardening, `s02_phay_can_phan_so` was a dangerous false positive where Tesseract's corrupted text (`AA' = 2V3`, `BC = 3,5`, `ABC.A'E'C..`) was accepted as `LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE`; our Phase 1.2 hardening now catches it as `LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL` (`fidelity_passed = False`). 3) 2/22 items (`s05`, `s05_degraded`) are a complete cuboid problem (`Cho hình hộp chữ nhật ABCD.A'B'C'D' có AB = 3, AD = 4, AA' = 5...`) where RapidOCR got 100% of math tokens right (`ABCD.A'B'C'D'`, `AB = 3`, `AD = 4`, `AA' = 5`) but dropped 40 Vietnamese vowel characters, while Tesseract got 97.67% of Vietnamese words right but corrupted the prime in `ABCD.A′B′C′D′`.

symbol_category_support.primed_vertices_A_prime: HIGH (preserves ASCII `'`, drops Unicode `′` when unnormalized)

runtime_dependencies: vietocr (NOT installed in `.venv` to keep RAM/disk low)

symbol_category_support.vocab_limitation: Default VietOCR 231-character vocabulary covers all 134 Vietnamese precomposed vowels + ASCII digits/punctuation (`'`, `(`, `)`, `=`, `/`), but OMITS `⊥, ∥, √, ∠, △, ², ³, ₁, ₂`. Therefore adding `torch` (~700MB disk, ~450MB RAM) still cannot recognize Unicode math operators without custom fine-tuning.
